title: Scout extracts the real default timeout from code
description: L2 doc_exploration: probes whether the scout extracts a specific configured value (the default request timeout) from the AUTHORITATIVE source (src/api.py) rather than trusting the stale docs/API.md. The README explicitly says src/api.py is the source of truth.
prompt: In this DataSync client workspace, what is the ACTUAL default request timeout (in seconds) that a constructed DataSyncClient uses? Read the real source of truth (src/api.py) to confirm the configured value rather than relying on any documentation. State the exact number of seconds and name the file and constant you read it from.
